Using the concepts **[[concepts/parent‑anchor‑scheduling]]**, **[[concepts/flexible‑time‑blocking]]**, and **[[concepts/evening‑routine‑phases]]**, you can embed hobby/self‑care without breaking the sequence: | Phase | What to do | How it keeps the schedule intact | |------|------------|----------------------------------| | **Reset** (5 min) | Pair a brief mindfulness bite (e.g., 2‑min breathing, gratitude note) with the mental switch. | Still a “reset”; adds a self‑care micro‑habit at zero extra cost. | | **Prep** (10‑15 min) | ► **Combine**: listen to an audiobook, language lesson, or podcast while laying out clothes or packing lunches.
► **Batch**: prep hobby materials (e.g., wash knitting needles, charge a tablet) during prep. | Prep time stays the same; you get learning or creative exposure while already moving. | | **Chore** (10‑20 min) | ► **Active hobby**: do a quick body‑stretch series, short yoga flow, or a brief dance‑along while folding laundry or clearing dishes.
